_note: Machine-readable failure memory. Every rejection appends an entry here AND a case in tests/golden/cases.json. CI (tests/run_gates.py) runs the mapped gate against every case that has a sample image; a gate that stops catching a past failure fails the build. All entries are global + category-agnostic. Human-readable narrative stays in config/QUALITY_MEMORY.json.

failures.description: accent run rendered with fewer stones than spec (diffusion undercounts; e.g. 10-15 vs 19)
accent stones rendered larger / more widely spaced than spec ratio
accent run stops short instead of covering the spec coverage_fraction
flush French/micro set rendered as a raised channel rail with a metal edge below the stones
hidden halo / basket pave invented under a primary stone the spec declares plain
accent stones added where the spec declares none
claws/prongs rendered split, doubled, broad or flared vs plain single elements
primary stone L:W drifts (oval->round, marquise->oval, hexagon->emerald)
structure/band restyled: taper/widening/flat when spec says uniform (no direct CV gate yet; caught in visual QA + spec-driven prompt)
duplicate / ghost second piece, clasp or link run in frame
primary scaled wrong vs structure / vs finger-hand
two or more slots rendered at effectively the same camera angle

failures.mistake: plain solitaire rendered with a pave-studded / hidden-halo basket UNDER the centre stone and a bulkier head than the slim source
failures.cause: hidden halos dominate modern solitaire training data; model 'upgrades' the plain basket in every render. Top-halo negatives do NOT cover the UNDER-stone gallery.
failures.rule: explicit under-stone lock: basket/gallery is PLAIN polished metal, zero small diamonds/texture/milgrain; total stone count = 1; slim head. Verification must ZOOM the under-stone gallery, not just glance at the montage. Auto-regenerate on failure. sku LR-0152

failures.description: logo/text AI-drawn on a studio render instead of the locked composited asset

failures.mistake: step-cut/baguette stones rendered rotated 90deg (north-south, across the band) when source is east-west (long axis parallel to the shank)
failures.cause: source-read error: orientation recorded as 'across band width' AND self-contradictorily labelled east-west; render followed the wrong description
failures.rule: orientation must state axis vs SHANK explicitly (parallel=east-west / perpendicular=north-south); verify long axis direction on a straight front view before writing 'certain'; G27 fits each stone long axis, >5deg off = FAIL

failures.mistake: partial (~3/4) stone row rendered as a FULL eternity (stones all the way around)
failures.cause: i2i/redraw extended the row; coverage not enforced as blocking
failures.rule: coverage_arc + plain_shank_arc are blocking (G27): partial band must keep a plain polished shank behind; reject full eternity

failures.mistake: single shared bead per junction rendered as doubled/V prongs
failures.cause: setting misread from a watermarked macro as French V-pave
failures.rule: single bead per junction; read the divider on a clean front view, not a watermarked crop

failures.mistake: spec/prompt described the section as a plain emerald/baguette row and OMITTED the mandatory alternating vertical PAIRS of small round brilliants between each emerald; with no anchor the model freely spaced AND rotated the rectangles
failures.cause: incomplete stone inventory — accent stones between the mains were misread as prong beads and left out
failures.rule: capture EVERY stone in the repeating unit (main + accents); accents between mains are mandatory in the prompt and lock spacing/angle. Also: French pave = V-cut notches, not generic shared prongs.

failures.mistake: ran generation on nano_banana_flash (banned) after nb2 routed to flash; treated an ambiguous 'generate all images' as a MODEL_LOCK waiver
failures.cause: interpreted a plain 'generate' instruction as an explicit policy waiver; it is not
failures.rule: MODEL_LOCK is absolute: if the served model != nano_banana_2, DO NOT GENERATE. A 'generate' instruction never overrides MODEL_LOCK. Only an explicit, model-named waiver could — and flash still produces wrong geometry, so never ship it.

failures.mistake: i2i redraw re-rotated/repositioned the emerald baguettes to north-south every time (editorial batch, house batch x4, single L1) despite corrected east-west spec + G27 verbatim prompt + full negatives
failures.cause: the generation MECHANISM redraws the ring; a redraw of a baguette row cannot preserve per-stone orientation. Flash is what is actually served, and it redraws. Prompt wording cannot fix a redraw.
failures.rule: STOP REWORDING (Continuous-Learning rule 4). Mechanism change required: only a path that keeps the REAL source pixels preserves orientation. Do NOT generate lifestyle via redraw/i2i on flash. Options: (a) true nano_banana_2 if it ever preserves, (b) an authorized composite of the real ring pixels into the scene. Until one exists, lifestyle for baguette/eternity SKUs is BLOCKED.
